_comment: Self-rated, and deliberately hand-written rather than computed from repo byte counts.
A byte-count radar would put JavaScript at the top of this profile, because the public
repos are side projects. The work that pays — the SBC layer, the Linux estate — is not
open source and contributes zero bytes here. The chart would be accurate about GitHub
Axes mirror the categories on geekksv.vercel.app/expertise so the two never disagree.
Scores are out of 10 and are a judgement, not a measurement. Edit them when they stop
being true; the workflow redraws the chart on push.

radar.why: Day-to-day owner of 10-25 Debian/Ubuntu servers in production
Runs the session border controller layer on OpenSIPS, ~1,000 concurrent calls
Python and Bash, scheduled through systemd timers and cron
Docker and Compose, Git and GitHub Actions; K8s and Terraform still ahead
Zabbix, Prometheus and Grafana across the estate
Server hardening; taught a three-day ethical hacking workshop; BS in Cybersecurity
